note: OpenAPI documents read back through vespera_core serialize again: a $ref next to type [T, null] keeps its $ref semantics (the type array null is dropped, like allOf), and an OpenAPI 3.0 nullable next to $ref plus type or anyOf becomes anyOf [schema, {type: null}]. An operation without responses no longer emits the invalid empty responses object. Reference Objects outside schemas (parameters, request bodies, responses, headers, examples) are documented as unsupported. JNI: the resumable DIRECT dispatch stashes a handler panic's 500 wire like any overflowing response (the handler never re-runs), answers an out buffer too small for a handle without dispatching, and reports a shutdown 503 that does not fit as an overflow instead of Integer.MIN_VALUE. vespera_inprocess re-exports resumable_from_wire.
